professionalSummary.text: Configures putaway and picking rules in a warehouse management system.
professionalSummary.witness: set up putaway and pick-face rules in the WMS training instance for a new handheld scanning workflow, covering three temperature zones and two pick-face sizes.

experienceHighlights.text: Writes work instructions for warehouse system processes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote 14 illustrated work instructions for receiving, putaway and replenishment on the handheld scanners, each with photographs of the scanner screens and the exception steps.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Has taken a warehouse system change into live operation on a working shift and supported users after cut-over.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Handheld scanning rollout at the Daventry site: per the client's account director, the new workflow 'has been live on every shift since the spring', with no paper pick lists left.

skills.text: Trains warehouse operatives on handheld scanning.
skills.witness: Trained 40 operatives over two weeks of half-day sessions in the training warehouse, a mocked-up aisle stocked with dummy cartons, keeping attendance records for each session.
